headline: Linn Mercy Erupts, DeadLands Keeps Firing as Lykos Fades
war_summary: Fresh despatches place Linn Mercy and DeadLands at the centre of the night's fighting. Linn Mercy, silent at the last edition, has logged four strategic-base actions in the past two hours and twenty-nine in the day, with recent fighting around Fort Duncan, Lathair, Outwich Ranch and the Prairie Bazaar; casualty and enlistment rates there are climbing sharply. DeadLands remains a live front, adding two actions in two hours and four in six, with both sides suffering more than twenty thousand casualties in a day. Lykos Isle, which flared overnight, has cooled—no action in the latest two hours after four in six. Fishermans Row and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet on flips despite heavy casualty counts. Weathered Expanse still exacts a fearful toll, with roughly twenty-four thousand Colonial and twenty-three thousand Warden casualties in a day, yet no strategic base has changed hands. Stonecradle, Tempest Island, and KingsCage, active earlier, have settled. Clahstra remains costly but static.
